summary: Evaluate AI use cases, outputs and risks with practical management tools. Explore the five-day AI literacy course and plan your training.
lede: AI literacy helps executives and managers assess proposed AI uses, review generative AI outputs and set workable human oversight in business processes. Through structured scenarios and spreadsheet exercises, participants check data suitability, test outputs for factuality and unsupported claims, assess value assumptions, map governance roles and prepare decision briefs, using the NIST AI Risk Management Framework and ISO/IEC 42001:2023 as reference points.
audienceIntro: This course suits people who approve, sponsor or oversee AI use in business processes and need to judge proposals without taking on technical model-development work.
modules: AI Value Cases and ROI Assumptions
prerequisites: Working experience in a management, executive or business decision-making role is recommended. No coding or machine-learning implementation experience is required.
topics: Generative AI at work & AI copilots
